## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] My changes work on Windows (the only supported platform).
- [ ] For behavior changes, I have tested the affected controls on a Windows desktop (launch, placement, details, speedtest, tray menu, hotkey, themes or multiple monitors).
- [ ] I have added or updated tests where applicable.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --locked` and `cargo build --release --locked` pass locally.
- [ ] Documentation builds without warnings using the checks in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] For window-layer changes, I have run the lifecycle test with Explorer running and checked that it did not skip the desktop assertions.
- [ ] I have updated docs and comments where behavior changed.
